Hero.title: Built in America. Trusted by Professionals Nationwide.
Hero.subtitle: Discover the story behind our commitment to purity, transparency, and B2B partnership.

Story.p1: 99 Purity Peptides began with a simple conviction: the U.S. peptide market deserved a domestic supplier that professionals could actually trust. No repackaged imports. No mystery purity. No gray-zone sourcing.
Story.p2: We built our operation from the ground up — U.S. laboratory, U.S. testing, U.S. team — so that compounding pharmacies, wellness clinics, and licensed researchers would have a reliable domestic source for research-grade peptides at competitive wholesale pricing.
Story.p3: Today we serve over 200 B2B clients across the United States, with an extensive catalog, tiered pricing, and full COA documentation on every order.
